prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Design a genuinely MINIMALIST desktop application UI for VideoDevour, a Chinese tool that turns videos into structured knowledge notes. User strongly rejected our previous dense blue dashboard with too many panels, borders, colorful thumbnails, icons, pills, tags, and actions. This revision must be radically quieter and more visually disciplined. Aim for the reduction and typography quality of exceptionally refined minimalist productivity software. The interface should feel almost obvious and effortless. STRICT ART DIRECTION: approximately 90% white or near-white surface, charcoal typography, ONE restrained medium blue accent (#3975D8) occupying less than 3% of the image. All surfaces fully opaque. NO glass, blur, gradients, heavy shadows, colored sidebars, ornamental artwork, texture, giant hero slogan, illustrated cards, statistics, avatar, notification bells, multiple pill filters, promotional banners, fake graphs, all-blue text, or thick borders. Generous but purposeful whitespace. Use only fine #E8EAED separators where needed, essentially no card chrome, 4px corners only on actual controls. Modest human-scale typography: normal 14–16px Chinese body copy, page title 26–30px maximum, clean restrained black/gray sans-serif, not a giant display type or serif magazine look. Very few icons. No redundant navigation or duplicated actions. Preserve the attached ORIGINAL blue whale logo as a small 28px brand mark at top left beside "VideoDevour", not as art elsewhere. All interface text must be crisp legible Simplified Chinese; keep copy short. Product content is illustrative. Minimalism must come from prioritization and removal, not from hiding functionality behind unreadably tiny text. Make it look like a real excellent application screenshot, not a wireframe, art poster or product landing page. Straight-on complete application filling the image edge-to-edge, no device frame, no perspective, no presentation border. Landscape 1600x1000. One finished UI per image. VARIANT A: THE QUIET VIDEO LIBRARY. No sidebar at all. A slim 64px white top navigation bar: original whale + VideoDevour on left; just "知识库" and "处理记录" in quiet text; "设置" at far right as text. Under it, a centered content column about 1040px wide within 1600px canvas. A compact page header "知识库" on the left and a small solid blue "整理视频" button on the right. One understated inline search field below, with only a bottom hairline and placeholder "搜索视频或笔记". Main content is a beautifully typeset LIST, NOT cards: five spacious rows, each containing a small neutral video icon or a tiny unobtrusive 40x30 thumbnail, the title, a single short muted summary, and at far right a muted date and small arrow revealed for the selected/hover row. Titles: "设计中的秩序与留白", "学习如何学习", "构建自己的知识体系", "好故事的结构与节奏", "界面配色的基本原则". No category pills, counts, durations, source icons, completion marks, bookmark buttons, preview panel, or progress bars in these rows. Hairline row separators, abundant horizontal breathing room, tight considered text hierarchy. The first row may have an extremely faint gray hover background, never a blue filled rectangle. Show approximately five rows and meaningful whitespace after them. Main action ONLY "整理视频". This should be the cleanest of the three, immediately readable, quietly confident, almost paper-like.
